question: What sum of money (in ₹) will amount to ₹2,280 at 4% per annum simple interest in 5 years?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Simple Interest percentage = Rate × Time = 4% × 5 = 20%

Total Amount = Principal (100%) + Simple Interest (20%) = 120% of Principal

⇒ 120% of P = 2280

⇒ P = (2280 × 100) ÷ 120

⇒ P = 1900

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,900.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amount (A) = ₹2,280

Rate of Interest (R) = 4% per annum

Time (T) = 5 years

 Principal = P Amount = ₹2280 
• 
 Time = 5 yrs, Rate = 4% p.a. + 20% Simple Interest Amount = P + (20% of P) = 120% of P 

**Formula Used:**

A = P × [1 + (R × T) ÷ 100]

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2280 = P × [1 + (4 × 5) ÷ 100]

⇒ 2280 = P × [1 + 20 ÷ 100]

⇒ 2280 = P × [1 + 0.20]

⇒ 2280 = P × 1.20

⇒ P = 2280 ÷ 1.20

⇒ P = 1900

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,900.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI) Formula

Interest is calculated strictly on the initial principal amount: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Compound Interest (CI) Formula

Interest is calculated on the principal along with accumulated interest: A = P × (1 + R ÷ 100)T.

Difference Between SI and CI

For the 1st year at a given rate, SI and CI are equal. For 2 years, the difference between CI and SI is P × (R ÷ 100)².
